title: Every log line reflects the operator-elicited environment, serviceName and serviceVersion
asA: operator debugging in a shared log destination
iWant: every log line to carry the environment, serviceName and serviceVersion the operator set at boot
soThat: log queries partition by those three fields without prose parsing on the message string

acceptanceCriteria.description: The logger factory refuses to construct when environment, serviceName or serviceVersion is missing or blank; construction failure throws with a message naming the missing field. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited environment, serviceName and serviceVersion on the boot-identity-fields elicit; the AC substitutes those values for the illustrative literals.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an application booting with one of the three fields absent
acceptanceCriteria.then: the construction throws, the error message names the missing field, and the process exits before any emission is possible

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every emitted line carries environment, serviceName and serviceVersion at fixed field names and equal to the values the operator supplied at boot. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited environment, serviceName and serviceVersion on the boot-identity-fields elicit; the AC substitutes those values for the illustrative literals.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application constructed with the three fields set
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's three fields equal the operator-supplied values verbatim

acceptanceCriteria.description: The factory refuses to construct when environment, serviceName or serviceVersion is set to a whitespace-only string; the thrown error names the offending field and treats blank as absent.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an application booting with serviceName equal to "  " (two spaces)
acceptanceCriteria.then: construction throws with a message naming serviceName as the offending blank field
